data.long_meaning: The name Babuli is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Babhru', which means 'happy' or 'blessed'. The name is often used for girls and is considered auspicious in Hindu tradition. The name Babuli carries the meaning “Blessed with happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Babuli usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
